description: Open the Sequenzy workspace view: a company's sequences and recent campaigns, each opening as a flow diagram or rendered email in MCP Apps clients. Read-only. Without companyId it uses the selected company and offers a switcher. The open view has its own tools (get_view_state, reload_view and others); call reload_view after editing what the user is looking at. Other clients receive the lists as data.

companyId.description: Optional company ID from get_account. Omit to use the selected company.

name: open_sequenzy

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `open_sequenzy` MCP tool.

campaigns.description: `items` (id, name, subject, status, updatedAt; up to 25), `total`, and `error` when unreadable.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

companyId.description: Company shown; null when the connection has no company.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

sequences.description: `items` (id, name, status, effectiveStatus, emailCount, updatedAt; up to 50), `total`, and `error` when unreadable.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

title: Sequences and campaigns
